'''Imre Talberenina''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] who once served on board the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Ballista (cruiser)|''Ballista'']] with [[Rodin Hlian Verpalion]]. Talberenina later served at the [[Melford Star Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]].
